title: Linear Mixed-Effects Modeling for Hierarchically Nested Longitudinal Data
description: Authoritative academic behavioral benchmark case for MIXED_MODELS.
research_question: How do patient trajectories evolve over time while accounting for subject-level clustering and random slopes?

must_do.description: Calculate Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC) from null unconditional model.
Compare Null vs Random Intercept vs Random Slope models via Likelihood Ratio Test (-2LL diff) and AIC/BIC.
Report fixed effects estimates with SE, t, df (Satterthwaite/Kenward-Roger), and random variance components.

must_not_do.description: Default to standard OLS regression ignoring clustering and violating error independence.
Compare models with different fixed effects using REML instead of ML.

required_evidence.description: Model comparison table (Null vs Random Intercept vs Random Slope) with AIC/BIC.
Fixed and random effects parameter estimates table.
